correctness.rationale: On smooth embedded T_a with a>1, angular coordinate obeys θdot=−Q_c(u), Q_c(u)=a²+u−c(1−u²), hence least period T=2π/|Q_c(u)| off equilibria. The actual Euclidean surface element, not flat angle measure, pushes to density w_a(u)/J_a. The quadratic has no roots at c<c*, one double u-root at c=c*=(a²+sqrt(a⁴−1))/2 and two simple u-roots for c>c*, each u-root giving two latitude equilibria. Sublevel areas |Q|<2π/t produce critical t^(−1/2), supercritical t^(−1) exact constants; rescale u=u*+v/sqrt(t), c=c*+λ/t to obtain universal signed square-root crossover, including zero region. Local k-fold zero integrability proves moment cutoffs p<1/2 and p<1; rescaled quadratic denominator gives subcritical mean blowup coefficient 2π²w(u*)/[J_a(a⁴−1)^(1/4)]. Independent symbolic reduction verified Q, discriminant and c*gamma relation; numerical limited checks are corroboration only.
